stem: The elements sodium to chlorine, in the third period, all form oxides.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Draw a diagram to show the shape of the molecule of each of the oxides, $\text{SO}_3$ and $\text{Cl}_2\text{O}$. Name each shape. In $\text{SO}_3$ each oxygen atom forms a double bond with the sulfur atom.

{{figure:visual_auto_01.png}}

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Explain why the melting point of $\text{MgO}$ is higher than that of $\text{Na}_2\text{O}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why the melting point of $\text{SiO}_2$ is much higher than that of $\text{SO}_3$.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem: $\text{SO}_3$ is produced by the reaction between $\text{SO}_2$ and $\text{O}_2$ in the Contact process. A dynamic equilibrium is established. $$2\text{SO}_2(\text{g}) + \text{O}_2(\text{g}) \rightleftharpoons 2\text{SO}_3(\text{g}) \quad \Delta H = -196\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$
parts.text: Explain why increasing the total pressure, at constant temperature, increases the rate of production of $\text{SO}_3$ and increases the yield of $\text{SO}_3$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why the gradients of the $\text{SO}_2$ and $\text{O}_2$ lines decrease with time.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Explain why all three lines become horizontal.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Suggest a reason why the initial gradient of the $\text{SO}_2$ line is steeper than that of the $\text{O}_2$ line.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem: 2.00 moles of $\text{SO}_2(\text{g})$ and 2.00 moles of $\text{O}_2(\text{g})$ are sealed in a container with a suitable catalyst, at constant temperature and pressure. The resulting equilibrium mixture contains 1.98 moles of $\text{SO}_3(\text{g})$. The total volume of the equilibrium mixture is $40.0\text{dm}^3$. $$2\text{SO}_2(\text{g}) + \text{O}_2(\text{g}) \rightleftharpoons 2\text{SO}_3(\text{g})$$
parts.text: Write the expression for the equilibrium constant, $K_c$, for the reaction between $\text{SO}_2(\text{g})$ and $\text{O}_2(\text{g})$ to produce $\text{SO}_3(\text{g})$.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the amount, in moles, of $\text{SO}_2(\text{g})$ and $\text{O}_2(\text{g})$ in the equilibrium mixture.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text: Use your answers to (d)(i) and (d)(ii) to calculate the value of $K_c$ for this equilibrium mixture. Give the units of $K_c$.
